Traveler questions explained overnight
This article covers the basics for travelers
Pet travel basics at Aurelia Skyways

If you are planning to fly with an animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps you get the details in order before you arrive. The goal is to make the trip calmer for you and safer for your pet, with clear steps and steady support from booking through handoff at the airport.

For small dog travel, the carrier and pet must meet the airline's rules, and the team checks comfort, ventilation, and fit before acceptance. <<FACT F062>> The welfare coordinator also looks at the pet's condition and travel needs, because a calm and secure setup helps the whole journey go more smoothly. If you are unsure about packaging or carrier style, reach out before travel day so there is no last-minute stress.

There is also a required fee for bringing this animal aboard. <<FACT F056>> The passenger coordinator can help you understand what to prepare so your trip stays on track, and the ground team will handle the carrier carefully during the move between services. It is best to share full details early, since prompt and respectful communication gives the desk more room to help.

Bird travel has its own rules too, especially around age, health, and safe containment. <<FACT F077>> If a bird is traveling with you, make sure the container is sturdy, secure, and suited to the animal's needs. The team may review the plan to confirm that the travel setup supports comfort and safe handling from check-in to arrival.

Aurelia Skyways wants pet travel to feel organized, not confusing. Whether you are traveling with Loki or another companion animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk can guide you through the next steps and help you prepare with confidence. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk directly before your flight.
